candidates.change_summary: Replace the final `return true;` statement with `return false;`.
Replace the final `return true;` statement with `return _tos.length > 1;`.
Compute the transferred amount as v * 10 ** _decimals + 1 instead of v * 10 ** _decimals, changing the amount passed to transferFrom.
Remove the revert on a failed transferFrom call so transfer returns true even when a token transfer fails.
Swap the direction of the token transfer by passing _tos[i] as the source and from as the destination in transferFrom.
Replace the loop with a version that breaks after the first iteration, so only the first recipient receives tokens.
Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so successful calls return false instead of true.
Remove the revert() on call failure so transfer returns true even when a transferFrom fails.
Change the require to require(_tos.length < 1) so transfer reverts for any non-empty recipient list.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) check so calling with an empty recipient list returns true instead of reverting.
Return false instead of true so the function's return value differs on every successful call.
Change the final return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so successful calls return false instead of true.
